}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== [https://doc.embedfire.com/linux/rk3588/quick_start/en/latest/quick_start/lubancat/lubancat2.html#lubancat-2n Spec.]
''LubanCat2 N'' and LubanCat logo are on top of board.
{{See also|List of Single-board computers}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3568 @2.0GHz :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A55); NPU: 0.8 TOPS *GPU: ''Mali-G52 MP2'' @650MHz (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.0) :VPU (with 4K VP9 and 4K 10-bit H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 32GB eMMC 5.1, TF card (max.512GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *USB: 1x USB 3.0 Host, 1x USB 2.0 Host, :1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) (OTG/Power) ports *Network: 2x 1GbE, 2x 2.5GbE ports *PCIe: PCIe 2.1 x1 *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 12V/2A via barrel or 5V via USB (Type-C)
